title: Stop Asking For An Easier Life (Stoic Motivation)
description:
You keep asking for an easier life. The Stoics answered that prayer two thousand years ago — and the answer is that an easier life is the worst thing that could happen to you.

Epictetus, born a slave, beaten and lame, didn't ask for things to go his way. He asked to become equal to whatever happened. Marcus Aurelius reminded himself each morning that no ungrateful or deceitful person could make him abandon his own character.

Difficulty isn't punishment. It's the only mechanism through which you become someone worth being. Stop asking for fewer problems. Start asking for more capacity. The hard parts weren't in the way. They were the way.

Subscribe for weekly cinematic motivation. New episodes every Wednesday and Saturday.

#stoicism #motivation #discipline #mindset #selfimprovement
